id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|74c0: An unfamiliar, fragrant scent drifts in the air...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|74c6: "Ho ho ho, smells lovely, doesn't it? It's a rotting corpse's grooming... a fragrant perfume.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|74d1: "We rotting corpse family make it together as a family.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|74d9: "But lately the world is overrun with fierce monsters, and delivering perfume is a struggle. Everyone's got a headache."
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|74ef: "What?! I can't hear you well!? ...Am I Colt's father?!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|74f6: "What nonsense, you fool. I'm Colt's grandfather, Ricardo. Don't mix me up with my son Smith.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7503: "Smith is shut in the lab in the back, making a fragrant perfume.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7511: "I'm Colt's grandfather, Ricardo. Don't mix me up with my son Smith. I'm a veteran with 300 years as a corpse.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|752c: "I'm Colt's grandfather, Ricardo. Don't mix me up with my son Smith. I'm a veteran with 300 years as a corpse.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|753e: "I'm Colt's grandfather, Ricardo. Don't mix me up with my son Smith. I'm a veteran with 300 years as a corpse.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7520: "Smith is shut in the lab in the back, making a fragrant perfume.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7555: "Ugh! Big brother, you're alive?! Wow! I've never seen a living human before!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7562: "Am I Colt's papa? No way! I'm Hansuke, and I'm only eight!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|756e: "Colt is a special beauty even among rotting corpses. Her pink hair suits her so well!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7593: "Me still fresh rot... Say, still plump corpse...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|759c: "...Me not Colt's father. Me still fresh rot... Say, still plump corpse...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|75a7: "...Me not Colt's father. Me still fresh rot... Say, still plump corpse...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|75b3: "...Me not Colt's father. Me still fresh rot... Say, still plump corpse...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7627: "T-then at least don't tell anyone about the mermaid! The favor of a lifetime!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7639: "R-really?! I heard city youths are cold, but that was a big lie! The village adults can't be trusted!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7647: "Wet kelp grows on a small island far north of Lonalulu, in a freezing country, I heard.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7654: "When you get the wet kelp, come back here, please. All right, traveler, I'm counting on you!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|768d: "When you get the wet kelp, come back here, please. All right, traveler, I'm counting on you!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|766a: "I want to help this mermaid somehow before the village adults find her! So...!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7675: "Please get me wet kelp, seaweed that soothes even the scratchiest throat in an instant!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7680: "Wet kelp grows on a small island far north of Lonalulu, in a freezing country, I heard.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|769d: "Oh, traveler! That bright face... You got the wet kelp, didn't you?! Quick, give it to the mermaid!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|76ba: "Thank you, traveler! Thanks to you, the mermaid can speak again!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|76f0: "Thank you, traveler! Thanks to you, the mermaid can speak again!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|76c2: "The mermaid's beautiful singing... hearing it, I'm not sure the village legend is really true anymore.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|76d0: "So I decided. From now on I won't swallow whatever adults say, and will see for myself what's right!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|76dc: "Now, traveler, this is my thanks! A treasured piece from a man who's grown up a bit!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|76f9: "But the mermaid's way of speaking is unique. When she thanked me like that, my chest tightened.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|771f: "Sor... ry... Me throat... hurt... Can't... talk well...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7730: "Sor... ry... Me throat... hurt... Can't... talk well...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7725: "If... wet... kelp... throat... scratchy... go away...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7735: "If... wet... kelp... throat... scratchy... go away...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|773f: "Th-that... wet... kelp! Me... want it! Wet... kelp, please...!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7760: "Ah, dream... saw... wet kelp...! Thank... you, traveler...! Eat... gladly...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|776b: "Voice comes out! My throat is moist beyond belief! Amazing, traveler, a miracle!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7775: "Ah, so happy. Now I can sing again! La la la~!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|777b: "But the happiest thing is I can properly thank the boy who stayed with me!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7784: "That boy desperately protected me... a brave, kind boy. I've gained new faith in humans!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|77ab: "That boy desperately protected me... a brave, kind boy. I've gained new faith in humans!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|77c8: "That boy desperately protected me... a brave, kind boy. I've gained new faith in humans!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7790: You gave the wet kelp to the mermaid! Report to the client nearby!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|779f: "Thank you, traveler. I'm happy. Happiest is that I can properly thank the boy who stayed with me!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|77bc: "Thank you, traveler. I'm happy. Happiest is that I can properly thank the boy who stayed with me!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d87: "Listen to me, you! When I tried to use the hellfire stone, the staff stopped me!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d93: "They screamed that an amateur using a hellfire stone would burn the whole place down, and banned me!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3da2: "If it's for me, a steam bath or two should be burned cheerfully. That's what business is!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1850: "I'm amazed someone came out of the sanctuary said never to move. I don't know who you are, but I'll help you...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2930: "Oh... I haven't seen you around. Meeting here must be fate. Do take a look at our wares.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d80: "...Oh, a traveler. I'm Miko, the priestess who rules this village of Hotto.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ef4: "...Oh, a traveler. I'm Miko, the priestess who rules this village of Hotto.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e08: "This is just a small, nothing village whose only merits are hot springs and smithing. Well, take it easy.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f7c: "This is just a small, nothing village whose only merits are hot springs and smithing. Well, take it easy.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e7c: "A man-eating firedrake once lived in the northern volcano. Each time it came down hungry, it tormented the people terribly.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7184: "A man-eating firedrake once lived in the northern volcano. Each time it came down hungry, it tormented the people terribly.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f78: "Unable to bear it, Lady Miko went with her son Lord Ryu to slay the man-eating firedrake.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7280: "Unable to bear it, Lady Miko went with her son Lord Ryu to slay the man-eating firedrake.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7030: "And Lord Ryu, at the cost of his own life, slew the firedrake splendidly. Truly those two are this village's heroes...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7338: "And Lord Ryu, at the cost of his own life, slew the firedrake splendidly. Truly those two are this village's heroes...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8644: "Lady Miko's son, Lord Ryu, defeated the firedrake with his natural swordsmanship, but lost his own life...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8740: "This is Lady Miko's room. It also holds the late Lord Ryu's keepsakes, so please refrain from entering.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9ad8: "This is Lady Miko's room. It also holds the late Lord Ryu's keepsakes, so please refrain from entering.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9e74: "Lady Miko and his son Lord Ryu went to slay the firedrake alone, while we stood by doing nothing.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a120: "Lady Miko and his son Lord Ryu went to slay the firedrake alone, while we stood by doing nothing.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9f40: "As village chief, he must have resolved to spare everyone, challenging it prepared to fall together...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a1ec: "As village chief, he must have resolved to spare everyone, challenging it prepared to fall together...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9ff4: "As for Lady Miko, who lost his only son, we priests intend to support him with all our strength from now on.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a2a0: "As for Lady Miko, who lost his only son, we priests intend to support him with all our strength from now on.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b57c: "...Oh? Could you have come for the hundred prayers too? Admirable for one so young.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b65c: "While this village was attacked by the firedrake, I prayed for its safety, making a hundred prayers for years.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c3a8: "While this village was attacked by the firedrake, I prayed for its safety, making a hundred prayers for years.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b74c: "Now the village is at peace, but I'll keep making the hundred prayers so everyone stays safe.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cae4: "Above here is Lady Miko, the priestess who rules Hotto. Take care not to be rude.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cbcc: "Above here is Lady Miko, the priestess who rules Hotto. But he's already resting today.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cc84: "If you wish to see Lady Miko, stay at the inn and come again in the morning.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cd60: "Oh, a traveler with a child, how rare. She looks quite small. Take good care of her.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ce50: "...Hm? You want the bar? The bar is in the east of the village, across from the weapon shop.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cf10: "...Hm? You want the bar? The bar is in the east of the village, next to the weapon shop.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|def8: "Hotto iron sells on its quality. Besides weapons and armor, we also sell the iron itself.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dfb4: "Gallopolis to the southwest is a regular customer. Merchants come often, since no other iron is this good.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e0c4: "Munch munch... My wife's cooking must be the best in Hotto... no, the world.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f358: "In smithing, you melt iron sand, cast a mold, then fold, hammer, hammer, hammer... and finally it becomes a sword.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f44c: "With that much effort, I can almost see why they say swords are possessed by something uncanny.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f544: "We both earn little. It's fine as is, but I want to settle down with this man soon.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|109f: "Smithing is Hotto's pride. The forge is up these stairs, so come see our work.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10ad: "Smithing is Hotto's pride. The forge is right there, so come see our work.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10bd: "Lord Ryu once saved me when I was attacked by monsters.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10c5: "My dream was for Lord Ryu to use a sword I forged someday... but that can't happen now.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10d4: "That lost girl seems to have come from elsewhere with her father.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10de: "But why did her father suddenly vanish? Something smells fishy...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|121f: "Lady Miko is the priestess who rules this village. And her son Lord Ryu was an exceptionally skilled swordsman.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|122b: "Lord Ryu risked his life to defeat the man-eating firedrake targeting this village... We truly lost a fine person...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1240: "With children, every day is like a war, but their sleeping faces calm me down.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|124c: "When these kids grow up, will they leave our home someday...?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13bb: "Until recently this place was menaced by a man-eating firedrake. Each day we never knew when we'd be eaten.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13c7: "The big volcano north of the village is Mount Huji, where the firedrake lived. The mountain gate is closed for safety.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13dc: "Oh, what brings you out this late? This is where Hotto iron is born.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13e3: "We're closed today, but the furnace still has fire, so don't touch anything.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|151d: "I came to this village seeking a new weapons supplier, and Hotto iron is quite good.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|152a: "Are you a traveler too? Then I recommend the weapons here. Do take a look.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|154e: "Hm... a very small lady, I see.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1553: "I don't know why she has no parents, but a small child alone worries me. Shall I order her something sweet?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1618: "The water flowing in Hotto is super hot hot spring water heated by Mount Huji.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|162d: "Ugh, if I leave my meal the fire god gets angry, so I must finish it... but I'm full and can't eat any more...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1708: "Lots of hot water wells up in Hotto, perfect for warming eggs.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1711: "If you draw Hotto's mark on a warm egg, it's a matchmaking egg, and a nice souvenir for travelers.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1722: "Hey, listen, big brother! Today's miso soup had ingredients in it! Hee hee, so happy!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|172d: "Before, when I asked for ingredients, Mom tricked me, saying look, there are miso grains in it.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17ed: "Ugh... that girl I met earlier seemed strong-willed and scary...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1803: "Ugh... sister is mean. She ate all my pickled radish, and I only had two slices...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1811: "In the house up the stairs live good siblings, Atsuo and Atsuko.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|181c: "In the house behind the weapon shop live good siblings, Atsuo and Atsuko.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1826: "They sometimes fight, but they're really close. I wish I had a sister too...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b21: "A traveler, how rare. This is Hotto, a village that lives with its volcano.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b2b: "The blue-haired fellow you were with went toward the steam bath. Up the stairs on the north side of the bar.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b40: "A little thing like you traveling as sisters? Don't be silly. Stop teasing adults!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b4b: "Anyway, bring your papa or mama. They're probably at the baths anyway?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b56: "Honestly... what an ordeal. I've been a guard here for ages, but never seen such a mouthy lost child.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b67: "Traveler, are you heading west? The monsters there are said to be tough.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b72: "And a black ghost that kidnaps people is said to appear around there. Go very carefully.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c98: "Oh, sir, traveling? You've come at a good time.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c9f: "The firedrake that eyed the village is gone, and the steam bath opened, all good things. Take it easy.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cb3: "Earlier I saw a small girl in strange clothes arguing with a bar server.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cbf: "They say smithing and fights are Hotto's flowers, but picking one with such a tiny girl... how childish.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cc9: "...What? Where did the girl go? She walked toward the village entrance.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cd7: "Oh... aren't you the girl thrown out by the bar server? ...What, you want to go to the bar?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ce2: "The bar is just up these stairs. With an adult you shouldn't be thrown out, but don't let her drink, even as a joke.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cf3: "The bar is in that building right there. With an adult you shouldn't be thrown out, but don't let her drink, even as a joke.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d06: "On the coast west of here is a mysterious labyrinth leading deep underground, and black ghosts reportedly appear there.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d14: "...What? You're heading to that west coast? A dare or whatever, but you have a small child, so be careful.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e85: "I came to spread the gospel, but the hot spring here feels so good I nearly forget my purpose. Now then...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f10: "Roaar, I'm the firedrake! I'll eat you all up!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f93: "I'm Lady Miko! I'll defeat the evil firedrake!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|203e: "Oh, traveler, after the steam bath? Go up those stairs and straight ahead into the building.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|204e: "Oh, traveler, after the steam bath? Go up those stairs and straight ahead into the building.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2061: "Atsuo and Atsuko really get along. I never tire of watching.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|206a: "...Oh, you've got an unfamiliar child. She doesn't seem to be from here. Did she get separated from her family?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2079: "Children are our future. If these children are safe, I've nothing left to regret.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2088: "Oh, bringing children out so late at night? Take them home.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2230: "A hot spring date on our first trip together, was that too much? I'll ask her again tomorrow.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2240: "Tch... I heard about the steam bath here and came, but my girlfriend isn't into it...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2264: "Tch... I heard about the steam bath here and came, but my girlfriend isn't into it...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|224d: "What are you? If you're done bathing, you've no business here. Stop staring and go away.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|225b: "What are you? If you're done bathing, you've no business here. Stop staring and go away.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2305: "I came to this village on my first date with my boyfriend. The food and clothes here are so different. How fresh!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2318: "Earlier a handsome blue-haired man went into the steam bath. Ahh, I'm so curious...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2325: "From his clothes he isn't from this village. If only I knew his name at least...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2332: "We came here on our first date. Taking a steam bath in a thin outfit, my boyfriend is bold to invite me here.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2343: "I heard this village prizes modest wabi-sabi, but maybe it's actually easygoing...?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2549: "After sweating in the steam bath, a drink here is the best. That's why I can't resist Hotto.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|255b: "Ahh! This heat! Dripping sweat! A steam bath in this village is made just for me!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2566: "Working up a good sweat, pal? A man gets stronger for every drop of sweat!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25f6: "Working up a good sweat, pal? A man gets stronger for every drop of sweat!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2605: "Like I said, I'm traveling with my sister. Believe a lady's word!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26c0: "Oh, welcome. The blue curtain is the men's bath. The red curtain is the women's bath.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26da: "Oh, welcome. The blue curtain is the men's bath. The red curtain is the women's bath.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26ca: "Travel builds up fatigue, doesn't it? Please relax at least until your next town.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|278a: "Oh my. Walking into the women's bath, how bold of you, sir.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2796: "The steam bath here is great for the skin! If you want to stay plump forever, take care of your skin.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|286a: "Ho ho ho... so impatient. The shop opens at night. Come back after sunset.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|287a: "Ho ho ho... a traveler, how rare. Seeing a young traveler reminds me of my own youth.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2889: "New people, new places, new cultures... Travel is full of surprise. Treasure each moment.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|298c: "Honestly, a kid walking into a bar alone, kids these days are precocious.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2996: "By the way, sir, are you traveling? I recommend the steam bath.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29a4: "Mutter mutter... Babysitting while serving at the bar is impossible, mutter mutter...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29ad: "Please, you two... find this kid's dad quick. I can't get any work done... sob...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a4b: "Earlier a little girl came by alone.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a5f: "Earlier a little girl came by alone.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a52: "She said she's looking for her sister, but what happened? I'm worried.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a65: "She said she's looking for her sister, but what happened? I'm worried.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a71: "You're going to look for Connie's father, aren't you? I'll watch her, so don't worry.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c43: "Oh, a customer? It's been a while, so I'm nervous. Um, uh...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cbd: "Hotto weapons are always sharp! Freshly forged and freshly honed! Now then...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d52: "Hotto armor is always fresh! Piping hot and just made! Now then...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dd1: "Phew, phew... so much sweat. If I stay here all day, I'll be steamed alive...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2de1: "Ugh... I've been extracting iron from iron sand all day, and I'm tired.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2deb: "Ahh... I'm hungry. Think I'll order a big bowl of rice today.

tm.今までに かいだことのない\nかぐわしい香りが 漂っている……。: An unfamiliar, fragrant scent drifts in the air...
tm.「ほっほっほ とっても いいニオイじゃろ？\n これは くさった死体の身だしなみ: "Ho ho ho, smells lovely, doesn't it? It's a rotting corpse's grooming... a fragrant perfume.
tm.「わしら くさった死体ファミリーが\n 家族みんなで 製造しておるんじゃ。: "We rotting corpse family make it together as a family.
tm.「しかし 近頃は 世界中が凶暴な魔物であふれ\n 香水を配達するのも 一苦労での: "But lately the world is overrun with fierce monsters, and delivering perfume is a struggle. Everyone's got a headache."
tm.「ええ！？ なんじゃって よく聞こえんぞ！？\n ……わしが コルトの父親かって: "What?! I can't hear you well!? ...Am I Colt's father?!
tm.「何を言っておるのじゃ たわけ者。\n わしは コルトの祖父のリカルドじゃ。\n: "What nonsense, you fool. I'm Colt's grandfather, Ricardo. Don't mix me up with my son Smith.
tm.「スミスなら かぐわしい香水を作るために\n 奥の研究室に こもっておるぞ。: "Smith is shut in the lab in the back, making a fragrant perfume.
tm.「わしは コルトの祖父のリカルドじゃ。\n 息子のスミスと 一緒にされちゃ こま: "I'm Colt's grandfather, Ricardo. Don't mix me up with my son Smith. I'm a veteran with 300 years as a corpse.
tm.「スミスなら かぐわしい香水を作るために\n 奥の研究室に こもっておるわい。: "Smith is shut in the lab in the back, making a fragrant perfume.
tm.「うげー！ お兄ちゃん 生きてるの！？\n すっげーな！ 生きてる人間って\n: "Ugh! Big brother, you're alive?! Wow! I've never seen a living human before!
tm.「ぼくが コルトちゃんの パパかって？\n そーんなわけ ないじゃーん！\n ぼ: "Am I Colt's papa? No way! I'm Hansuke, and I'm only eight!
tm.「コルトちゃんは くさった死体の中でも\n とくべつな 美人さんなんだよ。\n: "Colt is a special beauty even among rotting corpses. Her pink hair suits her so well!
tm.「ワタシ マダ クサリタテ……\n イウナレバ マダ ピチピチノ死体……。: "Me still fresh rot... Say, still plump corpse...
tm.「……ワタシ コルトノ父 チガウ。\n ワタシ マダ クサリタテ……\n イウナ: "...Me not Colt's father. Me still fresh rot... Say, still plump corpse...
tm.「じゃ…じゃあ せめて\n 人魚さんのことは だまっててほしいさぁ～！\n 一生: "T-then at least don't tell anyone about the mermaid! The favor of a lifetime!
tm.「ホ…ホントけ！？ いやぁ 都会の若者は\n つめてぇって聞いたけど ありゃ 大: "R-really?! I heard city youths are cold, but that was a big lie! The village adults can't be trusted!
tm.「ウルウルコンブが採れるのは ナギムナー村の\n ずぅっと北……すっごく 寒ぅい: "Wet kelp grows on a small island far north of Lonalulu, in a freezing country, I heard.
tm.「無事 ウルウルコンブを 手に入れたら\n ここに戻ってきてほしいさぁ～。\n: "When you get the wet kelp, come back here, please. All right, traveler, I'm counting on you!
tm.「オイラ 村の大人に見つかる前に なんとかして\n この人魚さんを助けてやりてぇ: "I want to help this mermaid somehow before the village adults find her! So...!
tm.「一瞬で どんなに イガイガしたノドも \n うるおすという海藻……ウルウルコン: "Please get me wet kelp, seaweed that soothes even the scratchiest throat in an instant!
tm.「ウルウルコンブが採れるのは ナギムナー村の\n ずぅっと北……寒ぅい国にある\: "Wet kelp grows on a small island far north of Lonalulu, in a freezing country, I heard.
tm.「おお 旅人さん！ その晴れやかなカオ……\n さては ウルウルコンブを 手に入: "Oh, traveler! That bright face... You got the wet kelp, didn't you?! Quick, give it to the mermaid!
tm.「ありがとなぁ 旅人さん！\n おかげで 人魚さんの声が\n 出るようになったさ: "Thank you, traveler! Thanks to you, the mermaid can speak again!
tm.「人魚さんの きれいな歌声……\n あれを聞いたら 村に伝わる言い伝えが\n ホ: "The mermaid's beautiful singing... hearing it, I'm not sure the village legend is really true anymore.
tm.「だから オイラ 決めたのさぁ。\n これからは 大人の言うことを うのみにせず: "So I decided. From now on I won't swallow whatever adults say, and will see for myself what's right!
tm.「さあ 旅人さん。これは 今回の お礼さぁ！\n ひと皮むけた男の とっておきの: "Now, traveler, this is my thanks! A treasured piece from a man who's grown up a bit!
tm.「しかし 人魚さんの しゃべり方は独特だなぁ。\n あの しゃべり方で お礼を言: "But the mermaid's way of speaking is unique. When she thanked me like that, my chest tightened.
tm.「ゴメ…ナサイ……\n ワタシ ノド イタ……\n ジョウズ… シャベレナイ……: "Sor... ry... Me throat... hurt... Can't... talk well...
tm.「ウルウル…コンブ…アレバ\n ノド…イガイガ トレルノ…。: "If... wet... kelp... throat... scratchy... go away...
tm.「ソ…ソレ… ウルウル…コンブ！\n ワタシ… ソレ…ホシイ！\n ウルウル…コ: "Th-that... wet... kelp! Me... want it! Wet... kelp, please...!
tm.「アア ユメ…ミタ ウルウル…コンブ……！\n アリガト…… タビビト…サン……: "Ah, dream... saw... wet kelp...! Thank... you, traveler...! Eat... gladly...
tm.「出る……声が 出るネ！\n ありえないほど ノド うるおってるよ！\n すごい: "Voice comes out! My throat is moist beyond belief! Amazing, traveler, a miracle!
tm.「ああ うれしいネ。\n これで また ウタ歌えるよ！\n ララララ～♪: "Ah, so happy. Now I can sing again! La la la~!
tm.「だけど…… いちばん うれしいのは\n 一緒にいてくれた ボウヤに\n ちゃん: "But the happiest thing is I can properly thank the boy who stayed with me!
tm.「あの子 必死で ワタシ かばってくれた……\n 勇気ある 優しい少年。\n ワ: "That boy desperately protected me... a brave, kind boy. I've gained new faith in humans!
tm.ウルウルコンブを 人魚に渡した！\n近くにいる 依頼者に 報告しよう！: You gave the wet kelp to the mermaid! Report to the client nearby!
tm.「ありがと 旅人さん……。ワタシ うれしいネ。\n なにが うれしいって 一緒に: "Thank you, traveler. I'm happy. Happiest is that I can properly thank the boy who stayed with me!
tm.「ちょっと ああた お聞きなさいざます！\n じごくの火炎石を使おうとしたら\n: "Listen to me, you! When I tried to use the hellfire stone, the staff stopped me!
tm.「シロウトが勝手に じごくの火炎石を使うなんて\n この店を 丸焼けにするつもり: "They screamed that an amateur using a hellfire stone would burn the whole place down, and banned me!
tm.「アテクシのためだと思えば\n 蒸し風呂屋の ひとつやふたつ\n 気前よく燃やす: "If it's for me, a steam bath or two should be burned cheerfully. That's what business is!
tm.「永遠に動かないと言われていた ほこらから\n 人が出てくるとは おどろきました: "I'm amazed someone came out of the sanctuary said never to move. I don't know who you are, but I'll help you...
tm.「おや……このへんじゃ 見ないカオだね。\n ここで会ったのも 何かの縁だ。\n: "Oh... I haven't seen you around. Meeting here must be fate. Do take a look at our wares.
tm.「……おや 旅人さんかい。\n 私は このホムラの里をおさめる\n 巫女の ヤヤ: "...Oh, a traveler. I'm Miko, the priestess who rules this village of Hotto.
tm.「ここは 温泉と鍛冶だけが とりえの\n なんてことない 小さな里さ。\n まぁ: "This is just a small, nothing village whose only merits are hot springs and smithing. Well, take it easy.
tm.「以前 北の火山には 人食い火竜がいてのう。\n ハラを空かして 里に下りてくる: "A man-eating firedrake once lived in the northern volcano. Each time it came down hungry, it tormented the people terribly.
tm.「それを見かねた ヤヤクさまは\n 息子のハリマさまと 共に\n 人食い火竜を: "Unable to bear it, Lady Miko went with her son Lord Ryu to slay the man-eating firedrake.
tm.「そして ハリマさまは ご自分の命と引き換えに\n 見事 火竜を討ちとりなさった: "And Lord Ryu, at the cost of his own life, slew the firedrake splendidly. Truly those two are this village's heroes...
tm.「ヤヤクさまのご子息である ハリマさまは\n 持ち前の剣術で 火竜を倒してくれま: "Lady Miko's son, Lord Ryu, defeated the firedrake with his natural swordsmanship, but lost his own life...
tm.「ここは ヤヤクさまの お部屋。\n 亡き ハリマさまの遺品も ありますので\n: "This is Lady Miko's room. It also holds the late Lord Ryu's keepsakes, so please refrain from entering.
tm.「ヤヤクさまと その息子のハリマさまは\n 我々が 手をこまねいている間に\n: "Lady Miko and his son Lord Ryu went to slay the firedrake alone, while we stood by doing nothing.
tm.「きっと 里の長として\n みんなを 犠牲にはさせまいと\n 相討ち覚悟で 挑ま: "As village chief, he must have resolved to spare everyone, challenging it prepared to fall together...
tm.「ひとり息子を亡くされた ヤヤクさまのことは\n これから 我々神官たちが\n: "As for Lady Miko, who lost his only son, we priests intend to support him with all our strength from now on.
tm.「……おや？ もしや そなたも\n お百度参りに 来たのか？\n 若いのに 感心: "...Oh? Could you have come for the hundred prayers too? Admirable for one so young.
tm.「まだ この里が 火竜に襲われていた時\n わしは 里の安全を祈って 何年も\n: "While this village was attacked by the firedrake, I prayed for its safety, making a hundred prayers for years.
tm.「もう 里は平和になったが\n わしは お百度参りを続けるぞ。\n 里のみんなが: "Now the village is at peace, but I'll keep making the hundred prayers so everyone stays safe.
tm.「この上には ホムラの里を治める巫女\n ヤヤクさまが いらっしゃる。\n くれ: "Above here is Lady Miko, the priestess who rules Hotto. Take care not to be rude.
tm.「この上には ホムラの里を治める巫女\n ヤヤクさまが いらっしゃる。\n しか: "Above here is Lady Miko, the priestess who rules Hotto. But he's already resting today.
tm.「ヤヤクさまに 会いたいのなら\n 宿に泊まるなどして 朝になってから\n 改め: "If you wish to see Lady Miko, stay at the inn and come again in the morning.
tm.「おや 子連れの旅人とは めずらしい。\n 見たところ ずいぶん小さい子のようだ: "Oh, a traveler with a child, how rare. She looks quite small. Take good care of her.
tm.「……うん？ 酒場に用がある？\n 酒場なら この里の 東の方にある\n 武器屋: "...Hm? You want the bar? The bar is in the east of the village, across from the weapon shop.
"...Hm? You want the bar? The bar is in the east of the village, next to the weapon shop.
tm.「ホムラの鉄は 質の高さがウリでな。\n 武器や防具にするのは もちろん\n 鉄: "Hotto iron sells on its quality. Besides weapons and armor, we also sell the iron itself.
tm.「南西の サマディー王国は お得意さんでね。\n こんなイイ鉄は ここでしか買え: "Gallopolis to the southwest is a regular customer. Merchants come often, since no other iron is this good.
tm.「もっしゃ もっしゃ……。\n うちの女房のメシは ホムラで……いや\n 世界で: "Munch munch... My wife's cooking must be the best in Hotto... no, the world.
tm.「鍛冶はね 砂鉄を溶かして 型を取ったら\n 何度も 折りかえしては 打って 打: "In smithing, you melt iron sand, cast a mold, then fold, hammer, hammer, hammer... and finally it becomes a sword.
tm.「それだけ たくさんの手間をかけるんだもの。\n 剣には 魔性が宿る……なんて言: "With that much effort, I can almost see why they say swords are possessed by something uncanny.
tm.「あたしたち お互いに かせぎが少なくてね。\n このままでも 気楽でいいけど\: "We both earn little. It's fine as is, but I want to settle down with this man soon.
tm.「鍛冶は このホムラの里の誇りだよ。\n この階段を上った先に 鍛冶場があるから: "Smithing is Hotto's pride. The forge is up these stairs, so come see our work.
tm.「鍛冶は このホムラの里の誇りだよ。\n すぐそこに 鍛冶場があるから\n ぼく: "Smithing is Hotto's pride. The forge is right there, so come see our work.
tm.「ぼく 魔物に襲われたところを ハリマさまに\n 助けていただいたことがあるんで: "Lord Ryu once saved me when I was attacked by monsters.
tm.「いつか ぼくが打った剣を ハリマさまに\n 使っていただくのが 夢だったんです: "My dream was for Lord Ryu to use a sword I forged someday... but that can't happen now.
tm.「どうやら あの 迷子の女の子は\n お父さんに 連れられて\n よそから やっ: "That lost girl seems to have come from elsewhere with her father.
tm.「……しかし あの子の お父さんは\n なぜ 急に消えてしまったんでしょう？\n: "But why did her father suddenly vanish? Something smells fishy...
tm.「ヤヤクさまは この里を治める巫女さま。\n そして その息子 ハリマさまは\n: "Lady Miko is the priestess who rules this village. And her son Lord Ryu was an exceptionally skilled swordsman.
tm.「ハリマさまは この里を狙う 人食い火竜を\n 命を張って 倒してくれた方で……: "Lord Ryu risked his life to defeat the man-eating firedrake targeting this village... We truly lost a fine person...
tm.「子供がいると 毎日 戦争みたいに\n あわただしくて 大変ですが\n 寝顔を見: "With children, every day is like a war, but their sleeping faces calm me down.
tm.「この子たちも いつか大人になったら\n 我が家を 巣立っていくのかしら……。: "When these kids grow up, will they leave our home someday...?
tm.「ここは つい最近まで\n 人食い火竜に おびやかされていてね。\n いつ食べら: "Until recently this place was menaced by a man-eating firedrake. Each day we never knew when we'd be eaten.
tm.「この里の北にある 大きな火山が\n 人食い火竜が棲んでいた ヒノノギ火山よ。\: "The big volcano north of the village is Mount Huji, where the firedrake lived. The mountain gate is closed for safety.
tm.「あら こんな夜中に なあに？\n ここは ホムラの鉄が生まれる所よ。: "Oh, what brings you out this late? This is where Hotto iron is born.
tm.「今日は もう 店じまいだけど\n かまどには 火が残っているから\n さわった: "We're closed today, but the furnace still has fire, so don't touch anything.
tm.「新たな 武器の仕入れ先を探して\n この里まで やってきたのですが\n いやあ: "I came to this village seeking a new weapons supplier, and Hotto iron is quite good.
tm.「あなたも 旅の方ですかな？\n それでしたら ここの武器をオススメします。\n: "Are you a traveler too? Then I recommend the weapons here. Do take a look.
tm.「ふむ……ずいぶん 小さなレディが\n いらっしゃるようですね。: "Hm... a very small lady, I see.
tm.「なぜ 親がいないのかは わかりませんが\n 小さな子が ひとりぼっちなんて 心: "I don't know why she has no parents, but a small child alone worries me. Shall I order her something sweet?
tm.「このホムラの里に 流れてるのは\n ヒノノギ火山で あたためられた\n と～っ: "The water flowing in Hotto is super hot hot spring water heated by Mount Huji.
tm.「うう ご飯を残すと 火の神さまが怒るから\n 残さずに 全部食べなきゃだけど…: "Ugh, if I leave my meal the fire god gets angry, so I must finish it... but I'm full and can't eat any more...
tm.「ホムラの里は あつ～いお湯が\n たくさん わいてきてね。\n タマゴをあたた: "Lots of hot water wells up in Hotto, perfect for warming eggs.
tm.「ホカホカのタマゴに ホムラの里の印を書くと\n 縁結びの ホの字タマゴっていう: "If you draw Hotto's mark on a warm egg, it's a matchmaking egg, and a nice souvenir for travelers.
tm.「ねえねえ 聞いて おにいちゃん！\n 今日のオミオツケは ちゃんと具が入ってた: "Hey, listen, big brother! Today's miso soup had ingredients in it! Hee hee, so happy!
tm.「前は 具を入れてって 頼んでも\n よく見れば おミソの粒が入ってるでしょって: "Before, when I asked for ingredients, Mom tricked me, saying look, there are miso grains in it.
tm.「うぅ……さっき会った 女の子\n 気が強そうで こわかったな……。: "Ugh... that girl I met earlier seemed strong-willed and scary...
tm.「うう……おねえちゃん ひどいや。\n ぼくのタクアン ふた切れしかなかったのに: "Ugh... sister is mean. She ate all my pickled radish, and I only had two slices...
tm.「階段を上った先の おうちには\n テバくんと サキちゃんっていう\n なかよし: "In the house up the stairs live good siblings, Atsuo and Atsuko.
tm.「武器屋さんの裏にある おうちには\n テバくんと サキちゃんっていう\n なか: "In the house behind the weapon shop live good siblings, Atsuo and Atsuko.
tm.「ときどき ケンカもしてるみたいだけど\n ふたりとも すっごく 仲良しなんだよ: "They sometimes fight, but they're really close. I wish I had a sister too...
tm.「旅人さんなんて めずらしいな。\n ここは ホムラの里。\n 火山と共に生きる: "A traveler, how rare. This is Hotto, a village that lives with its volcano.
tm.「あんたと一緒にいた 青い髪の兄さんなら\n 蒸し風呂の方へ 向かっていったぜ。: "The blue-haired fellow you were with went toward the steam bath. Up the stairs on the north side of the bar.
tm.「お前みたいな ちっこいのが\n 姉妹で旅なんか できるもんか。\n 大人を か: "A little thing like you traveling as sisters? Don't be silly. Stop teasing adults!
tm.「とにかく おとっつぁんか\n おっかさんを連れてきな。\n どうせ 風呂にでも: "Anyway, bring your papa or mama. They're probably at the baths anyway?
tm.「まったく……エライ目にあったな。\n ここの番兵を始めて ずいぶんになるが\n: "Honestly... what an ordeal. I've been a guard here for ages, but never seen such a mouthy lost child.
tm.「旅人さんよ 西の方へ行くのか？\n あの辺りの魔物は なかなか手強いと聞くぜ。: "Traveler, are you heading west? The monsters there are said to be tough.
tm.「それに あの辺りには 人をさらう\n 黒いオバケが 出るらしい。\n よくよく: "And a black ghost that kidnaps people is said to appear around there. Go very carefully.
tm.「おや お兄さん 旅行かい？\n こりゃまた いい時期に来たもんだねえ。: "Oh, sir, traveling? You've come at a good time.
tm.「里に目をつけていた 火竜は いなくなったし\n 蒸し風呂は開店されたし いいこ: "The firedrake that eyed the village is gone, and the steam bath opened, all good things. Take it easy.
tm.「さっき 見慣れない格好の\n 小さな女の子と 酒場の給仕が\n ケンカしている: "Earlier I saw a small girl in strange clothes arguing with a bar server.
tm.「鍛冶とケンカは ホムラの華と言うが\n あんな ちっちゃい子を相手に\n まっ: "They say smithing and fights are Hotto's flowers, but picking one with such a tiny girl... how childish.
tm.「……え？ 女の子が どこにいったかって？\n 里の入り口へ 歩いていったよ。: "...What? Where did the girl go? She walked toward the village entrance.
tm.「おや……そこにいるのは\n 酒場の給仕に 追いだされてた子じゃないか？\n …: "Oh... aren't you the girl thrown out by the bar server? ...What, you want to go to the bar?
tm.「酒場なら この階段を上って すぐの所さ。\n 大人が一緒なら 追いだされないと: "The bar is just up these stairs. With an adult you shouldn't be thrown out, but don't let her drink, even as a joke.
tm.「酒場なら すぐそこの建物さ。\n 大人が一緒なら 追いだされないと思うけど\n: "The bar is in that building right there. With an adult you shouldn't be thrown out, but don't let her drink, even as a joke.
tm.「ここから西の 海岸辺りには\n 地下深くに続く 不思議な迷宮があって\n とき: "On the coast west of here is a mysterious labyrinth leading deep underground, and black ghosts reportedly appear there.
tm.「……え？ アンタ その西の海岸に向かうのか？\n 肝だめしだか なんだか知らな: "...What? You're heading to that west coast? A dare or whatever, but you have a small child, so be careful.
